name: Introduction to Neuroscience
summary: A first course on the nervous system: neurons and synapses, brain organisation, senses, movement, and the biology of behaviour and mind.

topics.name: Neurons and glia: cell types and structure
The action potential and its propagation
Organisation of the nervous system: CNS, PNS and autonomic
Tour of the brain: brainstem, cerebellum, diencephalon, basal ganglia and cortex
Sensory systems overview: vision, hearing, touch, taste and smell
Motor systems overview: spinal reflexes to motor cortex
Methods for studying the brain: lesions, recording, imaging
